title: Name-Amendment Rate Table — Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing
content:
The name-amendment rate for a name amendment on a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate follows the other amendments on the filing's record.

| Filing's record shows | Name-amendment rate |
|---|---|
| Another amendment entered today | 5.00 |
| No amendment entered today, but two or more amendments within the past 12 months | 20.00 |
| Every other case — no amendment today and at most one within the past 12 months | 15.00 |

**Reading the table.** The first line is decided first: another amendment entered today sets the rate at 5.00 whatever the 12-month count. Every amendment entry counts, whatever its reason; "entered today" means an entry date of today.

**Window.** A window of a number of months covers the entries dated less than that many whole months before today, whole months being counted from the entry's date to today.

**Hypothetical records.**
- A policy number change entered on the filing's record this morning: 5.00.
- Nothing today; an address change 3 months ago and a vehicle change 10 months ago: 20.00.
- Nothing today; one vehicle change 10 months ago: 15.00.
- Nothing today; two amendments, 5 and 14 months ago: only one within the window, 15.00.
